chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) secondary to type 2 diabetes mellitus with pending kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient was first documented with diabetic kidney involvement in 2014 (CKD stage 1 and disorder of kidney due to diabetes). Over the subsequent years the disease progressed to CKD stage 2 (2023-05-10) and then to stage 4 by September 2023, accompanied by microalbuminuria (2023-05-10) and overt proteinuria (2023-09-13). In November 2023 the patient was placed on the kidney transplant waiting list. Throughout this period the patient has persistent allergic rhinitis and carries an epinephrine auto‑injector for a severe, undocumented allergy. No diabetes‑specific or renoprotective medications are recorded. Recent visits (last on 2024-12-22) continue to focus on renal follow‑up and transplant evaluation.

clinical_impression: The patient is a 14‑year‑old male with advanced diabetic kidney disease (CKD stage 4) currently awaiting kidney transplantation. The renal disease dominates the clinical picture and is compounded by early‑onset type 2 diabetes, likely uncontrolled hypertension, and absent renoprotective therapy. A severe, undocumented allergy is present, requiring an epinephrine auto‑injector. Significant data gaps (laboratory results, vital signs, medication list) limit full risk stratification and optimal management planning.
